title: kbmon's tools.md row names the panels by pointer, so parallel panel stories stop conflicting on one table row
goal: kb/_self/tools.md's kbmon row describes the command and points to kb/_self/monitoring.md for each panel's content, so stories that add or change different panels edit different sections of monitoring.md and do not conflict on one tools.md line

run:
import sys,re
t=open('kb/_self/tools.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
row=next(l for l in t.splitlines() if l.startswith('| `python3 _tools/kbmon.py'))
n=len(re.findall(r'the \w+ panel gives',row));print('panels described in the row:',n);sys.exit(0 if n==0 else 1)

notes: SP-v4yih547 close: four of six parallel kbmon landings (ST-iogk4rdb, ST-go6vdmnt, ST-bhvh6jh6, ST-d2ekxwvd) stopped or were pre-rebased for a conflict in the same tools.md row (and twice in monitoring.md's section order), each resolved by hand keeping both sides.
